review_summary: Glow like sunlight on skin with our new Vaseline Glazed & Glisten Shimmering Body Gel Oil —a luxurious, silky oil gel formula that melts into skin, leaving a light-catching, peachy champagne shimmer for a soft, sunlit glow—without tinting the skin. Transport your senses with an addictive fragrance blend of warm vanilla and toasted cocoa butter — enveloping skin in a glow and scent that lingers like soft daylight and sunshine on skin. It’s summer in a bottle. This lightweight, shimmering body oil glides on with a sheer, peachy glaze and dewy, glossy finish that absorbs quickly—no sticky residue, just transfer-resistant glow that catches the light. Powered by beauty from skin science, this body oil for dry skin is infused with skin-loving ingredients like ultra-hydrating lipids and 100% pure cocoa butter to help strengthen the skin barrier and lock in moisture—revealing visibly smooth, glowing skin that stays hydrated and looks as good as it feels. Designed with light-reflecting shimmer, this peachy golden-pink glow flatters all skin tones and skin types—delivering a lit-from-within radiance that enhances your natural beauty and leaves you glowing with confidence. Massage oil onto shoulders, collarbones, arms, and legs for radiant skin that catches light wherever the day takes you. Skincare meets self-care when you layer body oil after shower or bath with your favorite body lotion to lock in hydration, glow, and scent that lasts. From sunlit mornings and poolside lounging to desk-to-dusk days and soothing self-care evenings, this is your new glow-to essential from AM to PM.
